cases.name: secondary-conversion
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};int main(){D d;int(D::*p)()=&B::b;return (d.*p)()!=7;}

cases.name: primary-logical-slot
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};int main(){D d;int(D::*p)()=&D::b;return (d.*p)()!=7;}

cases.name: static-storage
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};int(D::*p)()=&B::b;int main(){D d;return (d.*p)()!=7;}

cases.name: argument-storage
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};int call(D&d,int(D::*p)()){return (d.*p)();}int main(){D d;return call(d,&B::b)!=7;}

cases.name: inverse-nonpoly-owner
cases.source: struct P{int x;};struct D:P{virtual int f(){return 7;}};int call(P&p,int(P::*f)()){return (p.*f)();}int main(){D d;int(D::*a)()=&D::f;int(P::*b)()=static_cast<int(P::*)()>(a);return call(d,b)!=7;}

cases.name: pure-virtual-address
cases.source: struct A{virtual int f()=0;};struct D:A{int f(){return 7;}};int(A::*p)()=&A::f;int main(){D d;return (d.*p)()!=7;}

cases.name: shared-virtual-owner
cases.source: struct V{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{int f(){return 7;}};int main(){D d;int(V::*p)()=&V::f;return (d.*p)()!=7;}

cases.name: nonvirtual-virtual-mix
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};struct E:D{int f(){return 5;}};int main(){E e;int(E::*p)()=&E::f;if((e.*p)()!=5)return 1;p=&B::b;return (e.*p)()!=7;}

cases.name: field-flow
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};struct H{int(D::*p)();};int main(){D d;H h;h.p=&B::b;return (d.*h.p)()!=7;}

cases.name: null-conversion
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};int main(){int(B::*b)()=nullptr;int(D::*d)()=b;return d!=nullptr;}

cases.name: constexpr-target
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};constexpr int(D::*p)()=&B::b;int main(){D d;return (d.*p)()!=7;}

cases.name: virtual-value-argument
cases.source: struct V{int x;V():x(3){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct I{virtual int read(A a){return a.x;}};struct D:I{int read(A a){return a.x+1;}};int main(){A a;a.x=7;D d;int(I::*p)(A)=&I::read;return (d.*p)(a)!=8;}

cases.name: overloaded-slot
cases.source: struct A{virtual int f(int x){return x;}virtual int f(double){return 2;}};struct D:A{int f(double){return 7;}};int main(){D d;int(A::*p)(double)=&A::f;return (d.*p)(1.0)!=7;}
